behaviours: a stage that finishes its own work exits 0, not 3
nvidia-smi header parser: box recording parses to driver 570.148.08 and CUDA 12.8; truncated, field-missing and error-line copies raise ValueError
nvidia-smi query parser: recording parses to the GPU name and driver; field-missing, error-line and truncated copies raise ValueError
etimes parser: value parses; an error line or empty output raises ValueError
rank table parser on the box table: 40 rows, top row swarm 0 glowworm 15 score -23.455, mapping by_name
rank table parser: truncated, field-missing, error-line, header-only, mixed-count and non-monotone tables raise errors that carry the raw lines and counts; the planted positional shape parses
PDB parser: box pose and pair file give the recorded atom counts and coordinates; a truncated pose raises ValueError
colabfold log parser: per-model times parse; a missing field, an error traceback or truncation raises ValueError (planted: no launch reached AlphaFold)
reporter file parser: last step and finite energies parse; missing field, truncation and error line raise ValueError (planted: no launch reached MD)
engine rate line parser gives the reporter's ns/day; malformed copies give an error or an explicit null, never a number
AlphaFold rows parser on rows the af2 stage wrote matches the replayed calls; a truncated copy raises ValueError
anchor stage on malformed rank tables: exit 2, a diagnostic file, the raw table kept, no verdict
anchor stage on a truncated pose: exit 2 and the anchor record still written
capability stage with malformed or failing nvidia-smi output: exit 2, failed record, no invented CUDA version
af2 stage with a failing prediction call: exit 2 and a failed record
af2 stage with a missing model time: explicit failure or null with a reason, never a fabricated number
endpoints stage with truncated AlphaFold rows: exit 2 and a failed record
stages given an empty --in exit 2 naming the missing file

anchor: serial and parallel calls use separate work directories and keep their own rank tables, top rows and poses (planted 1.5 A serial-parallel RMSD); a second invocation keeps its outputs apart from the first
aux: three per-pair docking calls keep their own work directories and rank tables, across two invocations
af2: nine prediction calls write separate results directories; each row carries its own call's model times and wall-clock, across two invocations
md: worker calls use separate work directories; each row carries its own call's engine rate, across two invocations
downloads: two fetches write separate files, each recorded with its own sha256, across two invocations in one payload
guard with a planted REMOTE_TIMEOUT of 3000 at 2450 s elapsed: exit 3, no tool called, inputs unmeasured_by_stop, and the record carries timeout, elapsed, allowance and estimate
guard with ample allowance under the same planted REMOTE_TIMEOUT lets the stage start
budget guard: price 3.00 and budget 5 stop at 6000 s and the record carries the arithmetic; price 1.99 at the same elapsed time goes
anchor: the reference scored against itself gives PASS, overlap 1.0, RMSD under 1e-6 and a zero frame shift
anchor: a rigidly translated copy of the reference gives PASS, overlap 1.0, RMSD and frame residual under 1e-6, 4142 atoms matched
anchor record diagnostics (self score, translated copy, rotated copy rejected, pairing, independent scoring) are present and ok, on both a pass and a fail
anchor on the box's recorded pose: FAIL, exit 4, the recorded RMSD 38.61633 A, run_valid false, RUN_VALID.json written
anchor on a rotated copy: exit 2 with kind anchor_frame, a diagnostic file, never scored
after an anchor miss every later record has run_valid false, the anchor's voided_by text and the miss label; endpoints exit 4
after an anchor miss calibration_valid and band decisions match the passing chain
a C1 run lacking a score file makes only C1 calibration_valid false and VOID with the raw value kept; endpoints exit 4
the anchor's verdict and values are unchanged by the stages that follow
an MD complex of 119,999 atoms or a NaN energy makes only C2 calibration_valid false
controls records: fields, sleep measured equal to the replayed sleep, unit-and-scale worked_examples
a sleep control that returns at once: exit 2 and a failed record
env_check: lock computed from the recorded pip freeze and equal; a different or unset lock exits 2; both nvidia-smi outputs read
anchor record: required fields, docking parameters of record with rank_table_columns, independent_code text, engine labels, kept rank tables
endpoint records C1 to C4: measured, unit, card value, band, decision against the band, calibration fields, gate fields, RUN_DONE statuses, summary first key and compute table
downloads records: byte-identical 6IHB copy, URLs and sha256s, pairs evidence matching the FASTA and PDB hashes
rows files of af2, md, aux and storage hold the stated fields
every stage writes only under --out
